gui.entitycontrol.breakspawn.equipment.h: §bItem selection and components editing directly use the selectors and editors supplied by KineticCore.
gui.entitycontrol.breakspawn.ui.equipmen: Left: the item (click to pick, edit components or clear). Right: drop chance on death (percent).
Left-click an empty slot to pick an item; right-click a slot to replace the item, edit its components or clear it.
Choose from the item selector; the item's own components is kept.
Edit the components of this item.

One item per slot. Left-click an empty slot to open the item search; right-click a slot for the menu (replace, edit components, clear). The number next to each slot is the chance in percent that the item drops on death. Changes go straight into the editor draft and apply after saving on the main page.
